# Public Memory Kernel Fixtures

Synthetic, public-safe Brainstack memory-kernel fixtures.

Rules:
- no real user names;
- no live Discord IDs;
- no canary strings;
- no provider tokens;
- no private URLs;
- no raw live transcript excerpts;
- no final-prose-only oracle.

Primary oracle:
- capture plan;
- admission decision;
- receipt coverage;
- evidence trace;
- selected answer evidence;
- dropped reason codes;
- reset recall fact set.

Budget fixtures prove:
- receipt-backed and authority-critical facts survive token pressure;
- support-only, stale transcript, and duplicate lower-authority evidence drops first;
- too-small budgets fail closed instead of dropping truth evidence;
- token-cost claims remain measured simulation, not production savings hype.

These fixtures are intentionally messy but safe. They include adversarial assistant output and correction pressure without copying private chat data.
